verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-payable API: agents can pay via MPP without an API key or signup, so the discovery axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows it is listed in, or publishes, a directory or discovery index of payable services. Its llms.txt and agents.md only index its own documentation, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit, and no OpenAPI or well-known discovery manifest was found.
